name: Broadsheet
tagline: The reading preset: 16 px text on a 24 px line in a 72-character column, hairline rules for boxes.
description: Broadsheet v0.2, the reading preset, as a drop-in look. What agents produce is writing (plans, reports, diffs, logs), so the hierarchy is built from type, measure and rhythm, not from boxes: reading text at 16 px on a 24 px line in a 560 px column (35 em, 72 characters a line as measured), code at 13 px, chrome at 13 px in 28 px rows, your prompt and the tool cards drawn with a faint wash or a hairline in place of a filled bubble, a sidebar and tab strip one quiet step of lightness off the page with a hairline between them, and color kept for links and status. Built only from public surfaces: two theme files (Broadsheet, light, the default; Broadsheet Dark), settings, and two stylesheets of public tokens. Remove it and everything you had comes back. A look cannot give code its own column or size tool rows apart from reading text, so both follow the reading text here; the README lists what this look does not set.
